$comment: App-level settings. Copied to hub.local.json (gitignored) on first build; edit that. familyName fills the greeting; set showGreeting=false to hide it. showAssistant toggles the AI assistant feature — set false to disable it entirely (no orb, no Spacebar shortcut; the dashboard grid reclaims the space). showOrb hides just the orb while keeping the Spacebar shortcut active (only applies when showAssistant is true). THEMES: themeMode 'single' uses `theme`; 'auto' switches between `themeDay` (from dayStart) and `themeNight` (from nightStart) on the wall clock. Theme names must match a theme block in theme.local.css — the hub discovers those at runtime, so custom themes work here too.
